item: OSM size read refuses without consent and under airplane mode, server-side (v0.6 C3)
summary: GET /api/geo/downloads/size made a live HEAD with the online consent held only in the page. The route now answers 400 without consent=true and a named 409 under the kill switch before any socket is opened (404 for an unknown code first); the Settings caller sends the consent after ensureOnline. Same pattern as the OpenTimestamps anchor and the OSM update route (invariant 14e).
